# CareerGPS Goa

CareerGPS Goa is a Goa-first career pathway intelligence platform for students, graduates, working professionals and career switchers.

## Primary pages
- https://careergpsgoa.in/ — Career discovery home
- https://careergpsgoa.in/careers — Career catalogue
- https://careergpsgoa.in/careers/software-developer — Software Developer career guide
- https://careergpsgoa.in/opportunities — Opportunities catalogue
- https://careergpsgoa.in/institutions — Institutions and courses
- https://careergpsgoa.in/learn — Learning catalogue

## Data principles
- Career and eligibility information should be backed by structured records and source evidence.
- Current recruitment facts should be verified against official notices before use.
- AI explanations are not the source of truth for current recruitment requirements.
